membership_source.role: item->event map and development/held-out MEMBERSHIP only
membership_source.held_out_membership_used_for: asserting every trained row is a development member

held_out_firewall.statement: No held-out human answer was read, inferred, reconstructed or used at any point.
files_never_opened: any HD plaintext containing held-out human answers
held_out_firewall.structural_guard: REPRODUCTION/predict_bass.py is label-blind by construction and its source is asserted by named test to contain no human-label read.

stem_evidence.statement: Stem-derived evidence is excluded entirely. No stem value serves as predictor or as Ground Truth.

storage.rationale: The frozen pipeline is a small JSON record. No audio copied, no array artifacts. Features are recomputed from the already-registered Phase A table.
storage.reading_of_PI_storage_gate: A 'persistent namespace' is read as a new SSD/HD experiment volume subject to the existing size allowances, not the canonical repository record directory. Flagged to the PI for confirmation.
